topic.description: What to teach — a concept name or question. Also the retrieval query and the concept_candidate key (unless mastery.concept overrides).

mode.description: Instructional stance the adapter should take. Does not change the deterministic scaffolding (scope, evidence, adaptation).

depth.description: Requested explanation depth; a hint to the adapter, orthogonal to the computed adaptation level.

mission_id.description: Mission slug whose declared corpora scope the retrieval (P9). One of mission_id / corpora is REQUIRED — scope is never guessed.

corpora.description: Explicit corpus-id scope override. One of mission_id / corpora is REQUIRED.

cross_corpus.description: Allow widening beyond scope when it under-fills top_k; widened evidence is flagged by the gateway.

top_k.description: Max evidence chunks to ground the lesson in.

mastery.description: Learner state from the coach mastery surface. Absent ⇒ unknown mastery (instruction starts at introduce; never claims mastery).

concept.description: Concept name this topic maps to (concept_candidate key + prerequisite lookup).

confidence.description: Critic-assigned confidence 0-1, or null when unverified.

prior_activity.description: Count of prior lessons/touches for this learner+concept.

prerequisites.description: Explicit prerequisite concepts with their confidence (overrides the concept-graph lookup; makes adaptation testable).
